UP CM disburses loan benefits and crop loss compensation to farmers

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has announced benefits for farmers, including subsidized loans at 6% interest and the release of ₹483 crore as compensation for crop damage due to floods. The compensation is intended to cover losses incurred by farmers, with the funds to be directly transferred to their accounts. The announcement was made from Gorakhpur.
